_comment: Colliding TRUE-positive corpus (Phase 2, issue #100). Each utterance genuinely contains a short dictionary term from dictionary-overfire.json (CRAN/Redis/Snyk/k8s/E2E/worktree/ultrathink) whose mis-ASR collides with a common English word. This is the recall arm the over-fire set lacks: when ASR mishears the term as a real word and the rescorer correctly fixes it, the candidate lexicon gate (Phase 1 Finding 3) would SUPPRESS that fix — so this corpus measures the gate's recall cost on exactly the case where it hurts. Caveat: macOS `say` may pronounce abbreviations (k8s, E2E) unlike a human; treat those terms' results as lower-confidence than the word-like terms (CRAN/Redis/Snyk).
